text:
Alex Chen: Hey team, customer reported a crash in their JSON-mode integration after a latency spike. They say our API returned a valid 200 but payload doesn't match the schema — parser error on their side. They claim the request was routed to an alternate model variant. Request id: req_0a7f2d.

Alex Chen: sample customer response (expected v2 schema):
```json
{"items":[{"id":"42","value":123}],"metadata":{"schema_version":"v2"}}
```

Alex Chen: actual response returned to them: 
```json
{"results":[{"uid":"42","val":123}],"meta":{"ver":"2b"}}
```

Alex Chen: parser exploded because keys are different. Customer saw this after a brief 1500ms P50 spike then smart-routing fallback to a cheaper variant. Impacting production for one customer (high volume ingestion). :exclamation:

Maria Gomez: ugh. can you paste the original request payload + headers + model param? Also which route (api key / route name)?

Alex Chen: sure — route: /v1/generate structured-json, route_name: ingest-ledger, model_hint: "redwood-large-v3". Request body (redacted):
```json
{"mode":"json_schema","schema":"ledger_v2","input":"...","max_tokens":128}
```
Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx, x-route: ingest-ledger

Alex Chen: config for that route has smart_routing: {"policy":"cost_preference","fallback_order":["variant-b","small-v2"]} — looks like variant-b handled the request.

Samir Kapoor: @Alex Chen thanks. likely root cause: variant-b was onboarded earlier and uses an older structured-output template. Smart routing allowed it as a fallback even though it doesn't guarantee the same output contract. We should confirm model metadata for "schema_compatible" flags. :eyes:

Samir Kapoor: quick mitigation: pin this route to redwood-large-v3 (disable fallback) for customers using strict schema, or restrict fallback set to only models labeled compatible with schema v2.

Evelyn (ENG-ML): can you attach the request_id and the full routing decision from logs? I want to verify which host/model served it and the kernel/quantization variant. I can run a compatibility smoke test across variant-b quickly.

Alex Chen: request id: req_0a7f2d. Routing log excerpt (from customer-provided screenshot):
```
[2026-02-12T11:04:52Z] req_0a7f2d assigned->pool:dedicated-12 node:n-42 model_hint:redwood-large-v3 fallback:variant-b served_by:variant-b commit:3a7f
[2026-02-12T11:04:53Z] variant-b response time: 1800ms tokens:54
```

Maria Gomez: marking this P1 for support. creating escalation ticket. @support-bot please open ticket and link eng teams.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created and assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml. SLA: 4h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026 :thumbsup:

Samir Kapoor: immediate short-term fix: update routing policy to include a compatibility predicate. Example: allow_fallback_if: model.metadata.schema_compat contains "ledger_v2". Longer term: model catalog should expose a canonical output contract + automated compatibility checks during model onboarding.

Evelyn (ENG-ML): agreed. I'll run a batch validation across prod variants for the ledger_v2 schema and post results here. If variant-b fails, we should revoke its compatibility tag and rollout a fast policy change to routes that have strict structured_mode=true.

Alex Chen: I have a repro curl from the customer that reproduces the payload mismatch locally (they say toggling schema_version to v1 calls still work). Repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v3","mode":"json_schema","schema":"ledger_v2","input":"tx summary"}'
```
Response (actual):
```json
{"results":[{"uid":"42","val":123}],"meta":{"ver":"2b"}}
```

Maria Gomez: can eng-runtime flip the route to pin for that customer while eng-ml runs compatibility tests? Customer is losing ingestion and has queued data.

Samir Kapoor: yes, I can push a temporary config: set route.ingest-ledger.allow_fallback=false for that customer id (tenant_93). Doing a canary change now.

Evelyn (ENG-ML): I'll start automated schema checks across variant-b and small-v2. If we detect stable drift we should mark variant-b as deprecated for structured outputs and schedule a model variant replacement. Also we should add a response validator in the serving layer that rejects nonconforming structured-mode outputs with a 502 and trigger fallback to a verified variant (instead of returning inconsistent payload).

Alex Chen: customer wants ETA. Impact: high, ingestion backlog ~2M events. Please prioritize. :pray:

Samir Kapoor: noted. pinning done for tenant_93, behavior should stop immediately. I'll follow up with rollback plan.

Evelyn (ENG-ML): preliminary tests show variant-b fails ledger_v2 contract on optional/renamed keys ~70% of the time. I'll upload a report to the ticket in 45m.

Alex Chen: thanks all. please keep updates here so I can share with the customer.

Maria Gomez: adding eng-runtime @channel and setting this incident P1.

Samir Kapoor: short-term action items: 1) pin route for affected tenant (done), 2) revoke schema_compat tag for variant-b if tests fail, 3) add compatibility predicate to smart_routing, 4) add a structured-response validator in the runtime.

Evelyn (ENG-ML): long-term: integrate schema regression checks in model onboarding + add unit tests for every schema we advertise.

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: keep me posted.
